title: Goldilocks and the Three Bears: Easy English Story
description: You can read the full story of Goldilocks and the Three Bears here. Tap any word for its meaning. Level A1, about 3 minutes to read.
intro: A hungry girl walks into a house in the forest and tries the porridge, the chairs and the beds that belong to three bears. The sentences are short, the words are simple and the tale repeats, so it suits A1 learners well.
